entities.name: Church of the Archangel Michael in Warsaw
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Michael the Archangel Church was an Orthodox church in Warsaw, located on Ujazdowskie Avenue, in the area of the current Plac na Rozdrożu. It was one of the military churches built for the needs of the Russian troops stationed in Warsaw, in particular the Lithuanian Regiment. Built in the 1890s, it was destroyed in 1923, during the recovery of churches recognized as symbols of Russian power during the Second Polish Republic.
